en.title: EU Procurement Reform Boosts Disability Rights; AI Buses and Apps Advance Accessibility
en.summary: The European Union has introduced proposed public procurement rules that could compel authorities to adopt more inclusive practices across infrastructure, transport, digital services and products. At the FIAA 2026 exhibition, Masats unveiled its AIDA AI system along with new doors and ramps to improve bus accessibility. Additionally, the Huana e指沖 app received accessibility certification for its voice assistance and haptic feedback features, and Hsinchu City bus drivers completed wheelchair‑experience drills to better understand accessibility needs.

highlights.title: Proposed Public Procurement rules give potential boost to disability rights
Masats brings AI to bus accessibility with AIDA system, new doors and ramps at FIAA 2026
Huana e指沖 App Earns Accessibility Certification with Voice Assistance and Haptic Feedback
Hsinchu City bus drivers undergo wheelchair experience drills to improve accessibility and handle sexual harassment

zh-TW.title: 歐盟採購新規提升殘障權益，AI巴士與App推動無障礙
zh-TW.summary: 歐盟提出的公共採購規則可能促使各機關在基礎建設、交通、數位服務與產品上採取更具包容性的做法。於FIAA 2026展會，Masats推出AIDA AI系統及新門與坡道，提升巴士無障礙性。華南e指沖App亦獲得無障礙認證，加入語音輔助與觸覺回饋功能，同時新竹市公車駕駛完成輪椅體驗演練，以加深對無障礙需求的了解。

highlights.title: 建議的公共採購規則有望提升殘障權益
Masats 在 FIAA 2026 展會上推出 AIDA AI 系統、新門坡道提升巴士無障礙
華南e指沖App獲無障礙認證 整合語音輔助升級聽觸覺互動
竹市公車駕駛坐輪椅體驗演練無障礙及性騷處置| 地方 - 中央社 CNA
